title: Go Golf
desc: Go Golf is a compact sports puzzle game where every stroke matters. Observe the terrain, aim precisely, and send the golf ball into the hole before you run out of turns.
howto: Use the mouse to line up each shot.
Choose enough power to reach the hole or a safe setup spot.
Avoid wasting strokes on rushed angles.
Clear each level within the stroke limit.
tips: Study the terrain before the first stroke.
Leave yourself a simple second shot when the direct route is risky.
Soft shots are easier to correct than overhit ones.
Use walls only when they create a cleaner final angle.
